summary: Iteration 7: Verified social icon mapping bug fix. Seeded leetcode + codechef via /api/admin/social-links, then loaded portfolio '/'. All footer social anchors, coding-profile cards, and floating-social anchors render correct brand icons (no lucide-message-circle) for github, linkedin, twitter, hackerrank, codeforces, leetcode, codechef, email. SVG innerHTML differs across brand anchors (no duplicates). Footer<->CodingProfiles parity holds for all 5 coding platforms (github, hackerrank, codeforces, leetcode, codechef) — path 'd' attributes match byte-for-byte. FloatingButtons parity holds. Admin /admin route loads without runtime errors. 0 console errors. Seeded links deleted afterwards.
critical_code_review_comments: socialIcons.js: 'x' exact matcher entry is unreachable because a prior 'x/twitter,x-twitter,twitter' entry uses substring includes — any single-char 'x' key would still hit 'twitter' first only if platform contains 'twitter'; standalone 'x' correctly falls through to the exact matcher, so behaviour is fine but the intent is subtle. Consider reordering or documenting.
Footer/FloatingButtons testids use raw platform value (e.g., 'footer-social-HackerRank') — mixed case. Consider lowercasing for consistency with coding-profile-* which is lowercased.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily added leetcode + codechef social links via POST /api/admin/social-links; deleted after test. Final DB state matches pre-test state (HackerRank, github, linkedin, twitter, email, codeforces).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Social icon mapping fully verified. If retesting, seed leetcode/codechef via admin API since portfolio has only 4 coding platforms configured by default (github, HackerRank, codeforces, plus optionally leetcode/codechef).
rca of the issue: Prior bug: Footer used a generic MessageCircle for platforms outside a small hardcoded map. Fix introduced /app/frontend/src/lib/socialIcons.js — a shared mapping using lucide-react + react-icons/si. Footer, CodingProfiles, FloatingButtons all consume getSocialMeta/getSocialIcon, giving consistent brand icons everywhere. Verified via DOM SVG class inspection and byte-comparison of <path d> across footer and coding-profile cards.
